title: Printmaker's Cabinet
provenance: Original Postern rehearsal authored 27 September 2026. Fictional mechanisms; not Wrenmere canon. Difficulty is not human-calibrated.

intro.storyOn: The last proof of the evening is missing from the dispatch tray. Ink hangs in the air, a plate waits behind a lettered cabinet, and the collection hatch has not yet opened. Restore the printmaker’s working sequence.
intro.storyOff: Make a correctly registered dispatch proof, then read its stamps using the route plan. Face and Mirror are explicitly defined fictional transfer modes.

ending.storyOn: The dispatch hatch opens onto a clean tray. A proof you made, rather than a password you found, supplied the final information.
ending.storyOff: The dispatch hatch opens onto a clean tray. A proof you made, rather than a password you found, supplied the final information.

solution.storyOn: The jobs must run B, A, D, C: enter BADC. Take the plate and fit it to the press, ink it, choose Mirror, and align the center triangle. KCOD reverses to DOCK. Pull the proof. Match its stamps to ascending route distance: Archive 2, Loft 3, Quay 4, giving stamps 2, 9, 6. Enter 296 at the dispatch hatch. The printed proof survives later press adjustments.
solution.storyOff: The jobs must run B, A, D, C: enter BADC. Take the plate and fit it to the press, ink it, choose Mirror, and align the center triangle. KCOD reverses to DOCK. Pull the proof. Match its stamps to ascending route distance: Archive 2, Loft 3, Quay 4, giving stamps 2, 9, 6. Enter 296 at the dispatch hatch. The printed proof survives later press adjustments.

text.storyOn: Jobs are A, B, C and D. B immediately precedes A; D follows A and precedes C. The plate cabinet uses all four letters in job order.
text.storyOff: Jobs are A, B, C and D. B immediately precedes A; D follows A and precedes C. The plate cabinet uses all four letters in job order.

text.storyOn: A lettered cabinet holds one removable plate.
text.storyOff: A lettered cabinet holds one removable plate.

text.storyOn: The plate is on the shelf. It reads KCOD and bears a triangle registration mark.
text.storyOff: The plate is on the shelf. It reads KCOD and bears a triangle registration mark.

text.storyOn: You carry the KCOD plate, marked with a triangle.
text.storyOff: You carry the KCOD plate, marked with a triangle.

text.storyOn: The KCOD plate is fitted to the press; the shelf is empty.
text.storyOff: The KCOD plate is fitted to the press; the shelf is empty.

text.storyOn: Face reproduces the letter order unchanged. Mirror reverses the letter order. The calibration word on a successful proof must read DOCK. Registration positions: left circle, center triangle, right square. Match the plate mark and apply ink before pulling.
text.storyOff: Face reproduces the letter order unchanged. Mirror reverses the letter order. The calibration word on a successful proof must read DOCK. Registration positions: left circle, center triangle, right square. Match the plate mark and apply ink before pulling.

text.storyOn: Distances from the booth: Quay 4; Archive 2; Loft 3. Dispatch requires destination stamps in order of increasing distance, not alphabetic order.
text.storyOff: Distances from the booth: Quay 4; Archive 2; Loft 3. Dispatch requires destination stamps in order of increasing distance, not alphabetic order.

text.storyOn: The ink has dried into three destination stamps: Quay 6; Archive 2; Loft 9. Compare these with the route plan.
text.storyOff: The ink has dried into three destination stamps: Quay 6; Archive 2; Loft 9. Compare these with the route plan.

text.storyOn: The hatch accepts the ordered destination stamps after a valid proof has been produced.
text.storyOff: The hatch accepts the ordered destination stamps after a valid proof has been produced.
